description: Economic releases with forecasts, prior values and the actual once it prints, plus Fed speakers and auction times. Defaults to yesterday through the next 7 days; widen days_back and days_ahead to see more, or filter to one country like US, EU, GB or JP.

country.description: Two-letter country or bloc, like US, EU, GB, JP. Empty means everywhere.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to include. Default 7, up to 365.

days_back.description: How many days of already-printed events to include. Default 1, up to 90.

name: get_economic_calendar
title: Economic calendar
